mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in FEDFUNDS below 5.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST (demand) above 1400 units triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it reflects heightened consumer demand and corporate optimism.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST crosses above 1400, or the increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low FEDFUNDS (<5.5%) and rising GDPC1 (demand) create a dual accommodative environment, amplifying equity valuation growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns not positive over 60 days despite concurrent signals, or GDPC1 growth not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (labor) and UNRATE (labor) simultaneously signal robust job market growth and low unemployment, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies meet the trigger, or the increase in UNRATE is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS below 5.5% amplifies equity valuation growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive in late-cycle expansion periods despite FEDFUNDS below 5.5%, or regime not active.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO (supply) above 102.5 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it reflects stronger production capacity and corporate optimism.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses above 102.5, or the increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (labor) and UNRATE (labor) simultaneously signal robust job market growth and low unemployment, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive despite trigger, or UNRATE increase not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in FEDFUNDS above 5.5% signals higher interest rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not negative in tightening periods despite FEDFUNDS above 5.5%, or regime not active.
